lede: Wall Street suffered its sharpest drop in months as AI chipmakers sold off on the day of Anthropic's record Nasdaq debut and a weak Philly Fed survey added to growth worries, with the S&P 500 down 2% for a sixth straight loss. Gold sank 2.6% to a 14-month low below $3,650 as a December Fed hike stays almost fully priced, while Bitcoin slipped toward $61,500.
snapshot_time: NY close Thu 19 Nov · FX ≈07:00 TRT Fri

focus.text: Fell 2.6% to $3,625, a 14-month low, as a ~90% priced December Fed hike outweighed softer yields; sitting on Thursday's low. Fed's Waller (16:25) and Cook (20:15) speak today.
Stuck just under 1.10 near 19-month lows (~1.0973) as Fed hike bets underpin the dollar; 1.0950 is nearby support. Lagarde's banking-congress keynote and US UMich sentiment (18:00) are today's risks.

technicals.indicators: RSI(14) H4 ≈ 26 (oversold) · below 20-SMA and 200-day MA · MACD negative
technicals.note: Gold has broken below the 3,700 area and printed a fresh 14-month low, extending a sequence of lower highs since the 9 Nov peak near 4,158.

technicals.indicators: 19-month lows · hammer candle at the lower H4 Bollinger band
technicals.note: The pair remains capped below 1.10 after the breakdown; the H4 hammer points to a possible corrective bounce within the broader downtrend.

technicals.indicators: Below 200-day MA since early Oct · 50-day EMA ≈ 1.3350 · daily momentum near oversold
technicals.note: Cable has slipped beneath its October low, its ninth decline in eleven sessions, fully erasing the rally that began on 14 Oct.

technicals.indicators: Below all major MAs (three converge near 75,500) · death cross flagged · Fear & Greed 12
technicals.note: Bitcoin is leaning on the floor of its 62,000–65,000 box that has held since 14 Nov, with lower highs on the hourly chart.

news.text: S&P 500 lost 2.02% to 7,175.83, a sixth straight drop; the Dow fell 2.19% to close under 50,000 and the Nasdaq shed 2.25%.
Nvidia fell 3.3% despite record quarterly revenue and AMD dropped 7.7% after a short report; Anthropic ended its debut at $97.17 versus the $83 offer price.
Jobless claims rose to 203k (197k expected) and the Philly Fed index sank to 6.3 from 20.9, yet futures still price a December hike at about 90%+.
Japan's October core CPI rose to 2.2% y/y, slightly below the 2.3% forecast; most economists expect a BoJ hike to 1.50% on 17–18 Dec, with USD/JPY near 160.
Silver slid 4.7% to about $42.83 alongside gold; Brent settled near $92, little changed on the day.
US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $306m of net outflows on Wednesday with no fund taking in money; assets fell to $77.7bn, a three-month low. Ether ETFs lost $39.8m.
The Fear & Greed index sits at 12 (extreme fear); Bitcoin is roughly half its October 2025 record and about $390m of positions, mostly longs, were liquidated in 24h.
CFTC chair Selig said on-chain venues such as Hyperliquid must register or partner with licensed exchanges to serve US retail; Binance.US filings were deemed substantially complete, not approved.
NEAR (−7.9%) and UNI (−6.3%) led large-cap losses; Clearpool is swapping CPOOL 1:1 into the new CLEAR token today.
Citi cut its 12-month Bitcoin target by 12% to about $99,500, citing the break below the 200-day average.

upcoming.note: Has floated a larger December hike; Cook follows at 20:15.
EZ 12:00, UK 12:30, US 17:45; US composite prev 55.9.

upcoming.note: Advance GDP +3.4%; Sep PCE 3.6% y/y, core 3.1%. Claims moved up for Thanksgiving.
Last regional survey before the 9 Dec FOMC.
NYSE and Nasdaq closed; thin FX liquidity.
